item.title: Royal London lodges plans for Wilmslow’s first BTR scheme
item.description: Royal London House off Alderley Road is to be redeveloped into 286 apartments under plans submitted to Cheshire East Council. The post Royal London lodges plans for Wilmslow’s first BTR scheme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cityheart secures Gateway 2 approval in Stockport
item.description: Branded as Lyme, the 16-storey block is one of three residential buildings being brought forward at the developer’s Stopford Park scheme. The post Cityheart secures Gateway 2 approval in Stockport appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Scottish Govt, Muse, Ion, and Manchester join Place MIPIM programme
item.description: The latest speaker additions to our packed calendar of events will join Glasgow City Council, East Riding of Yorkshire Council, Liverpool City Region Combined Authority, WSP, Drum Property Group, and more in putting a global spotlight on the North of England and Scotland’s investment potential. The post Scottish Govt, Muse, Ion, and Manchester join Place MIPIM programme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester’s ‘quiet miracle’ homelessness scheme completes
item.description: Embassy Village will provide 40 homes for rough sleepers beneath 22 railway arches in Castlefield after more than 130 organisations contributed to the creation of the project. The post Manchester’s ‘quiet miracle’ homelessness scheme completes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Essar, Spirit, and Progressive team up for carbon capture infrastructure
item.description: The proposed shipping import terminals would transport industrial carbon dioxide emissions from elsewhere in the world to the Morecambe Net Zero carbon store in the East Irish Sea. The post Essar, Spirit, and Progressive team up for carbon capture infrastructure appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Parliament approves Stockport MDC expansion
item.description: As Greater Manchester lines up equivalent zones across the city region, its first Mayoral Development Corporation will see its boundary tripled to cover the whole town centre. The post Parliament approves Stockport MDC expansion appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Adanola founder buys distinctive Northern Quarter office
item.description: Marlsbro House on Newton Street, recognisable for its chequerboard cladding, is the latest Manchester asset acquired by Hyrum Cook. The post Adanola founder buys distinctive Northern Quarter office appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Bennett takes Wirral reins
item.description: Already serving as interim chief executive, Matthew Bennett’s appointment to the role permanently will be ratified at a meeting of full council next week. The post Bennett takes Wirral reins appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: RPs on alert for Stockport opportunity
item.description: The council is looking to offload the site of the former Greendale House office block in the town centre to a housing association to deliver a 100% affordable scheme. The post RPs on alert for Stockport opportunity appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Tatton takes management in house following slew of senior hires
item.description: Fisher German will hand over the keys to chief executive Pete Crowther and his newly assembled team after 20 years managing its various assets. The post Tatton takes management in house following slew of senior hires appeared first on Place North West.
